source: src/script/state/game.ts (cloud/cirrus field options and altitude functions, copied)
notes: Float arrays are float32: fnv1a32 over little-endian bytes, base64 when small, else head + every 97th element. Indices are hashed as Uint32. Field cells are dealt with Rng(seed) in place of Math.random. layout[tile][cell] = [model, offsetX, offsetZ, quaternion.y, quaternion.w, lodBias]. drawn = [tile, cell, x, y, z, lod, triangles] per entity the field rendered, in call order. planes are three.js Frustum planes [nx, ny, nz, constant] from projScreen (column-major).
